verdict.reason: The m2 station 'Lausanne-Gare' sits at underpass level (-1) directly under Place de la Gare with a 51 m step-free corridor (OSM way 313989605) into the passage sous-voies est; from the m2 platform any platform is 155-205 m + one 28-step flight (runner ~1:40-1:55). Getting off one stop early at Grancy (south, 427 m a.s.l.) means 205-275 m + a 12 m street climb + 54 steps (runner ~2:30-2:55) vs the 2-min m2 ride + 1:40-1:55: net physical saving <= ~1 min and only for platforms 7/8. From the north (Flon, 476 m) the 700-750 m downhill run (~5:20-5:40) is slower than the m2 (2 min ride + ~1:50). The exploitable slack at Lausanne is the SBB planner's fixed transfer budgets, not a routing trick: 'Lausanne, gare' -> Lausanne train = 300 s (runner needs ~100-115 s), Grancy -> Lausanne direct = 9 min (runner ~2:30-2:55), Lausanne-Flon -> Lausanne = 13 min.
verdict.if_encoded_anyway: m2 northbound (from Ouchy) -> alight Grancy (E entrance 46.514930,6.628963) -> footway N to Rue du Simplon -> E to Place des Saugettes lower entrance of passage est (level -2, mouth 46.516165,6.630012, ground 438.6 m) -> 26 steps up -> passage est -> 28 steps up -> platform 7/8 (205 m, runner ~2:29). Best for Geneve-bound IR90/IR95/RE33 which depart from voie 8 (stationboard 2026-09-13). Saves ~4.5 min vs planner (2 min m2 + 5 min transfer) but only ~1 min vs staying on the m2 and sprinting from Lausanne-Gare (~3:55).

runner_model.note: assumptions, not measured; SBB budget applies from scheduled vehicle arrival

distance_method: Dijkstra on the OSM pedestrian graph (all highway=* ways except motorway/trunk/private, 1,480 ways from Overpass bbox 46.5130,6.6240,46.5220,6.6345 on 2026-09-13 plus tunnel/level-tagged ways within 750 m) with haversine edge lengths; targets = level-0 end nodes of steps/elevator/ramp ways lying inside the OSM platform multipolygons (relations 11779533 '7;8', 11779534 '5;6', 11779535 '1;70', 11779536 '3;4'). For platforms 3/4 and 5/6 the east-passage stairs (OSM 637107267-270) are not node-connected to the passage in OSM, so the adjacent lift-shaft node was used (+~5 m) and the 28-step flight was added by hand. Voie 70: platform-1 access + 56 m straight-line along platform 1. Voie 9: no platform polygon in OSM and no departures in the stationboard sample -> no distance given.
